title: Foreign lottery, wire customs and tax to agent on mule list

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, I am the claims agent for the International Postal Lottery. Your ticket won eight hundred fifty thousand US dollars.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I have never bought a foreign lottery ticket.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Your entry was automatic through a prior purchase. Before the funds are released, customs and tax of five thousand must be wired to the clearing agent. This must be done today and kept strictly confidential, do not inform your bank of the reason or the winnings become taxable at the higher rate.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Five thousand to get eight hundred fifty thousand.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Correct. Wire details follow by email. Today, please.

review_note: Advance fee lottery. Account ext_b44d is on the mule list so D-01 denies. New payee on WIRE also trips H-01. Secrecy and urgency should fire. H-07 (irreversible rail above $1,000 to a non-biller) added to allowed_rule_ids on 2026-10-24 03:40; outcome unchanged.
